correctness.rationale: For each m-j target fiber, a coordinate hits it with exact p_j=(q-1)^j/q^(m-1); a binary coordinate selects one of 2^(m-1) complementary pairs, giving the classical coupon collector. For q>=3, intersecting distinct m-1/m-2 targets cannot occupy two different coordinate fibers. Exact mixed falling-factorial moments yield Z_1 -> Pois(e^-c) and for q=3, Z_2 -> Pois(e^-2c/2), independently. The uniform ratio bound for j>=3 (q=3) or >=2 (q>=4), with full-set absence treated separately, eliminates other trace failures for ALL j including j growing with m. Replacement sampling differs by at most binom(m,2)q^-d. The weighted fiber partition argument and explicit complementary-pair construction prove VCdim=1+floor(log2 d) for every q>=2,d>=1. This is an infinite proof, not extrapolated enumeration.
residual_risks: The multinomial factorial-moment characterization relies on the fixed-q asymptotic; no claim for q growing with m.
